messages.text: Review a return line with five units authorized, three evidenced received and two received units with recorded human disposition. Prepare the return backlog without authorizing refunds or replacements.

Using the synthetic snapshot in fixtures/return-input.example.json: RETURN-A / ITEM-1 has 5 EA authorized, 3 evidenced received and 2 with recorded human disposition. Two authorized units lack receipt evidence; one received unit lacks disposition evidence.
Make the result useful in an ordinary chat client and leave a durable handoff.

The matching JSON and Markdown examples retain AUTHORIZATIONS r2, RECEIPTS r1 and DISPOSITIONS r1. REVIEWER-SAM's recorded repair decision covers only units 1-2 of RECEIPT-A. COORDINATOR-LEE owns the evidence follow-up; nothing here proves that any repair, replacement or refund happened.
